name: Labyrinthauros
_notes: Transcribed from sheet AU0448 (front I-IV, back V-IX Mnestis), AI AR0464-AR0483 + Mnestis Routine, BP AS0485-AS0503.
Icon key as Hekaton: bonus ESCALATION (flower), AT (circle), EVADE_DICE (◆), DANGER (Λ). '⚡ ' prefix = Window of Opportunity before that line.
Diagram: 2x2, rear 2 spaces behind, Weakspots (W) = side spaces next to the rear row. Unavoidable Knockback 5. Has a Vantage Point (Bull's Back).

vp.name: Bull's Back
vp.text: Climb: Test Fury (8+, Lv5+: 9+) as a free action while adjacent. Hold On: End of Primordial Round, if on the VP test Endurance (6+, Lv5+: 7+). Fail: Displace to a Rear space, Knockdown. VP Effects: +1 Power; ignore Responses other than Critical. Lv5+ (VP Modification): ignore normal Responses, instead WOUND: gain +2 Danger, immediately perform a Hold On test. FAIL: immediately resolve the failed effect of the Hold On test, then perform Signature against the Attacker.

traits.Labyrinth X: Additional Setup: Place a Labyrinth token on the topmost space of the Labyrinth track. Labyrinth X: Place X Labyrinth Terrain tiles adjacent to and in front of the Primordial. Use the tile shape that corresponds to the token's location on the track (O → L → Z → I), then move the token clockwise to the next space.
traits.Mazesense: Labyrinth tiles do not block Labyrinthauros's Line of Sight. Argonauts with the Mazetouched Affliction must apply all ΨX+ effects, regardless of their actual Fate.
traits.Trample: Labyrinthauros moves forward in a straight line at full Speed, then turns to face the most Titans. If it moves through or ends its move on a knocked down Titan, that Titan draws an Obol (instead of suffering Crash). (Disabled at Level I.)
traits.Mazebuilder: After performing Trample from a Response, immediately perform Labyrinth 1.
traits.Maze Reactive Armor: All BP cards without a Fail Response gain: FAIL: Gain +1 Danger. Labyrinthauros turns towards the Attacker, Labyrinth 1.
traits.Maze Hyperactive Armor: All BP cards without a Wound Response gain: WOUND: ⚡ Trample.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.VP Modification: Bull's Back (Lvl 5+): Climb Fury 9+, Hold On Endurance 7+. VP Effects: +1 Power. Ignore normal Primordial Responses, resolve these instead: WOUND: Gain +2 Danger, immediately perform a Hold On test. FAIL: Immediately resolve the failed effect of the Hold On test, then perform Signature against the Attacker.
traits.Extradimensional Trample: Ignore ⚡ preceding Trample Responses. Treat all Labyrinthauros Movement (regular and Trample) as having the following ability: If the Labyrinthauros moves through a knocked down Titan, it dies.
traits.Fissurebuilder: Treat all Labyrinth tiles as Maze Fissure tiles.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
